item.title: [LOW] Jordan's Cybercrime Unit warns of deepfake accounts impersonating public figures
item.description: Jordan's Cybercrime Unit cautioned that fake accounts were using AI deepfake audio and video of public figures to steer citizens to fraudulent websites for financial scams and data theft. Target: Jordanian citizens; impersonated public figures. JO. Verification: reported.
